title: The Description of a Pain That Was Small
youtube_title: The Description of a Pain That Was Small | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Nim about description of a small pain that still deserved the whole sentence. Nim wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
